packaging_changes: Core model, reward adapter, and their support modules copied byte-for-byte from v6 sources.
Frozen upstream archive replaces the local git archive dependency.
Training defaults use portable parent paths and the recorded eight-step horizon.
Training completion dispatches the existing independent four-cohort evaluator.
FirstEpisodes and wilson_interval extracted unchanged into a small standalone helper.
Added configuration launcher and artifact preparation for evaluation.
Human-readable records replace the original absolute training directory with <training-workspace>.
Comparison record excludes unrelated old-branch process status.
Binary checkpoints remain unchanged; their stored historical paths are metadata only.
Self-contained integration under algorithms/physical_belief_rocket_landing; no environment files changed.
Source overlay directory renamed from src/common to core; frozen runtime namespace retained.
Public entry points, checkpoints, configuration and reports use descriptive names; historical IDs stay in provenance.
Added an English report and kept the Chinese report.
